description: Animates a still image into a short video clip from a start frame (PixVerse 3.5).

prompt.description: Prompt for the video generation. PixVerse I2V allows empty prompt.

duration.description: Duration of the output video in seconds. Allowed values: 5 or 8.

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

img_id.description: Pre-existing PixVerse image handle (the `asset_id` previously returned by `createPartnerAsset({ model: 'pixverse/image-handle' })`). When supplied the dispatch skips the per-call upload. Mutually exclusive with `image`.

motion_mode.description: Motion mode (subject to silent override at L2 when quality=1080p or duration_seconds != 5).

negative_prompt.description: Optional text description of undesired elements. Empty string is dropped from the wire body at L2.

quality.description: Output video resolution / quality. Setting to '1080p' silently forces motion_mode='normal' and duration_seconds=5 at L2.
